meta.name: api-ai-together-ai
meta.description: Together AI SDK patterns for TypeScript — client setup, chat completions, streaming, structured output, function calling, embeddings, image generation, fine-tuning, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 TypeScript 调用 Together AI 的各类 AI 能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用 TypeScript 集成 Together AI 的聊天、生成、微调等 API
copy.tagline_en: Call Together AI APIs from TypeScript for chat, generation, fine-tuning, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Together AI's chat, generation, fine-tuning APIs in TypeScript

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 Together AI 的 TypeScript SDK 调用 200 多种开源模型（如 Llama、Qwen、Mistral、DeepSeek），完成聊天、流式输出、结构化 JSON 提取、函数调用、图片生成、嵌入向量和微调等任务。
howto.when: 当你需要运行开源大模型、生成图片、创建嵌入向量或微调模型时触发。也适用于从 OpenAI 迁移到开源模型的场景。

say.text: 帮我用 FLUX 模型生成一张日落山景图。
say.note: Claude 会展示图片生成的 API 调用方式。

say.text: 用 Qwen 模型提取这段文本中的事件信息，输出为 JSON。
say.note: Claude 会使用结构化输出功能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you use the Together AI TypeScript SDK to access 200+ open-source models (e.g., Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek) for chat completions, streaming, structured JSON output, function calling, image generation, embeddings, and fine-tuning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to run open-source LLMs, generate images, create embeddings, or fine-tune models. Also applies when migrating from OpenAI to open-source models.

say_en.text: Write TypeScript code using Together AI's Llama model.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code examples for the Together AI SDK.

say_en.text: Generate a sunset mountain image using the FLUX model.
say_en.note: Claude will demonstrate the image generation API call.

say_en.text: Extract event details from this text as JSON using Qwen.
say_en.note: Claude will use structured output functionality.
